title: Assert relative Git-directory output in the outside-directory setup regression
outcome: Assert relative Git-directory output in the outside-directory setup regression
acceptance: The ordinary-Git-directory regression asserts raw rev-parse --git-dir and --git-common-dir outputs are relative before setup runs from an outside directory, so an absolute-output fixture change cannot silently remove relative-join coverage.
The strengthened regression and required repository checks pass on its reviewed input.
